tickets.title: Prepare approximately $25,000 charitable transfer instructions
tickets.text: Prepare approximately $25,000 transfer instructions for Sela Mossbutton’s 2026 charitable giving to Moonbadger Arts Center’s youth-workshop fund. Verify brokerage details and confirm the transfer of appreciated Velvet Acorn Growth Fund shares from the joint-taxable account with Jonah Mossbutton, if manageable.
tickets.evidence: by 2026-01-23 prepare approximately-$25,000 transfer instructions after brokerage-detail verification
